description: cfd_2d_6dof_fish_x198 with the discrete recoil correction of the grid (X 196 2): a planar rigid-body motion of the deformation in the body frame (axial, lateral, rotation), integrated with the RK stages of the body, its rates minus the rigid-body fit of the deformation velocity in the hull region of the grid at each forcing; the fit of u* takes the deformation at t^n with the correction of t^n.
covers: sixdof_obj::deform_stage of the correction (TVD RK3), deform_step_end
